candidate.title: G&T-seq
candidate.scope: The assigned G&T-seq poster row at schematic scope: a single cell yields physically separated bead-captured poly(A) mRNA and genomic DNA, processed independently by the shown Smart-seq2 and MDA components, sequenced separately and linked at the data level. The verified collection heading and matching schematic identify the same target. The adjacent DR-Seq row, clipped text above it, and EDTA chemical legend are context, not alternatives within this assigned row. Smart-seq2 and MDA are embedded operations, not additional target methods. RNA-to-cDNA carrier interpretation is distinguished from the drawn RNA substrate using the supplied G&T-seq-derived adaptation evidence; no bisulfite workflow is imported. This is not an executable protocol or a claim that every G&T-seq implementation uses MDA.

operations.label: Streptavidin magnetic bead with mRNA capture primer
operations.description: Capture poly(A)-bearing mRNA from the lysate on the primer-bearing bead; DNA remains outside that capture complex pending separation. The bead/primer is an added capture reagent.
